decisions.story_title: RatHat Android malware uses AI-powered subsystem for device control, linked to Chinese threat actors
decisions.reason: Novel Android malware with AI-driven automation for remote device navigation. Uses Accessibility abuse, ADB persistence, HTML overlays for banking fraud. Attributed to Chinese threat actors based on LLM prompts in Chinese. Distributed via malvertising and SMS phishing.

Second actively exploited Cisco zero-day in two days. CVE-2026-76460 in ISE API allows unauthenticated root access. Already clustered into existing Cisco ISE story by deterministic engine. CISA KEV added.
